name: qyl.mcp
description: qyl MCP host, telemetry tools, MCP Apps viewers, and local resource dashboard

scripts.build: bun run --cwd server build && bun run --cwd workbench build && bun run --cwd dashboard build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd server test && bun run --cwd workbench test && bun run --cwd dashboard test && bun run postbuild && node --test scripts/build-site.test.mjs
scripts.smoke: bun run --cwd server smoke && bun run --cwd workbench smoke
scripts.dev: bun run --cwd server build && bun run --cwd dashboard dev
